panels.description: Recorded executions in the selected time range. Complexity is interpreter operations per execution; duration is elapsed execution time, not CPU time. Maxima are histogram bucket estimates and p95 is interpolated. >500,000 ops / >20 s indicate histogram overflow; overflow values sort above finite estimates and tie with each other. Empty cells mean unavailable data. Panic-aborted runs may not record these histograms. Click a trigger to inspect it.

properties.value: Interpreter operations per recorded execution. Percentiles and maxima are histogram estimates.
